name: Sullivan County, IN
findings: Sullivan County has 67 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Sullivan County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Sullivan County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.
